description: Writes the CAST for an AI Video Story series (named characters, each with a role and a one-line description) as a DRAFT for the user to read. FREE: it spends no tokens, generates no portraits and saves nothing to the character library. WHEN: as soon as the episode idea is settled, on a series whose `cast.required` is true (or whose user wants custom characters). Do NOT ask permission: it costs nothing and the webapp writes this roster automatically at the same point. Never call it for a `cast.writer_owned` series, which casts itself. WHAT IT RUNS: a showrunner model reads the series and your `idea` and answers with the cast that idea needs; IT DOES NOT WRITE THE STORY. The response's `idea` is the one you sent, unchanged (translated if needed); with NO `idea` the call authors a logline and returns that, which the user has not seen: show it and ask whether to keep it. AFTER: show the names and roles, one line each, and never present their own idea back as news. If they dislike the roster, call this AGAIN with a sharper `idea` (a re-draft is free and replaces it); never buy portraits for a cast they have not accepted. THE PRICE OF THE NEXT STEP RIDES THIS RESPONSE: `portraits_needed` (the members whose `needs_portrait` is true; a preset-bound member arrives photographed and costs nothing) and `portrait_models`, each with `per_portrait_tokens` and the roster's `total_tokens` (`default: true` is what the series is tuned for). Use those figures verbatim; never multiply anything yourself. `generate_cast_portraits` with this `draft_id` is the money step (the draft stays redeemable about two hours). WEBAPP-ONLY: renaming a member, adding your own, adding one from a photo. Never re-draft the whole cast for one member: once portraits are bought, `describe_cast_member` changes what one member IS. A 400 `invalid_request` for a series that ships its own FIXED cast, casts itself or has no cast-first flow means: go straight to `generate_story_video` without a cast. A 429 `utility_rate_limited` is the free AI-writing allowance shared with the webapp: wait the `retry-after`, never top up tokens.

idea.description: The episode idea the cast should serve, one short paragraph: pass the user's idea whenever there is one. Only when omitted does the writer author a logline.

language.description: Omit unless the user asked for another language (the series' `defaults.language` is used). Pass the SAME language to `generate_story_video`.

series_id.description: The series id, exactly as `list_series` returns it.

world.description: The visual world for the cast (`fruits`, `humans`, `animals`). Unset lets the writer pick.

name: generate_cast
title: Write a story cast (free draft)
